question: Should OpenClaw sponsor real-time multi-operator dashboard presence as part of the bundled modular dashboard roadmap, and what identity/editing data may be exposed to connected operators?
rationale: This is a new multi-user dashboard capability layered on an unmerged dashboard stack and it exposes operator activity, so automation cannot choose the product, privacy, and scope boundary safely.

options.title: Keep as dashboard roadmap task
options.body: Preserve this issue as the focused follow-up and implement it only after the dashboard foundation lands with a reviewed identity/scope contract.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker only
options.body: Track presence only under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 if maintainers do not want separate dashboard subtask issues open yet.

options.title: Move outside bundled dashboard
options.body: Require the presence experiment to live in an external plugin path if the bundled modular dashboard direction is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Keep as dashboard roadmap task
recommendation.body: Preserve this issue as the focused follow-up and implement it only after the dashboard foundation lands with a reviewed identity/scope contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal for the plugin-tab and presence infrastructure that would constrain this product decision.
